title: TrafficEvent
description: A single event ingested by the TrafficCopilot ingest pipeline. May originate from sensors, cameras, manual officer reports, or radio transcripts.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event (UUID v4).

source.description: Data source that produced this event.

event_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred.

ingested_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was received by the ingest pipeline. Set by the server.

corridor_id.description: Identifier for the road corridor this event relates to (e.g. I5-SB-42).

lat.description: WGS-84 latitude of the event location.

lon.description: WGS-84 longitude of the event location.

payload.description: Source-specific payload. See oneOf sub-schemas for typed payloads.

oneOf.title: SensorSpeedEvent
oneOf.description: Speed and occupancy reading from a loop detector, radar, or Bluetooth/Wi-Fi sensor.

segment_id.description: Road segment identifier this sensor is associated with.

speed_kmh.description: Space-mean speed of traffic measured at this sensor (km/h).

free_flow_kmh.description: Free-flow reference speed for this segment (km/h).

occupancy_pct.description: Lane occupancy as a percentage of the measurement interval.

volume_veh_per_hour.description: Measured flow rate in vehicles per hour (optional).

oneOf.title: CameraMetaEvent
oneOf.description: Computer vision metadata derived from a CCTV or IP camera feed.

camera_id.description: Unique identifier of the camera device.

lane_blocked.description: Whether the CV model detected a blocked lane.

vehicle_count.description: Number of vehicles visible in the camera frame.

incident_detected.description: Whether the CV model detected an anomaly consistent with an incident.

confidence.description: Model confidence score for incident_detected classification.

image_url.description: Optional URL to the frame image stored in object storage.

oneOf.title: ManualIncidentEvent
oneOf.description: Incident manually reported by a field officer or TMC operator.

reporter_id.description: Unit or badge identifier of the reporting officer.

vehicle_count_involved.description: Number of vehicles involved, if known.

oneOf.title: RadioTranscriptEvent
oneOf.description: Transcribed radio communication from a field unit, processed via STT.

transcript.description: Full STT transcript of the radio communication.

unit_id.description: Radio unit identifier of the transmitting officer.

channel.description: Radio channel the transmission was received on.

oneOf.title: CADDispatchEvent
oneOf.description: Computer-Aided Dispatch event pushed from the CAD system integration.

incident_type_code.description: CAD incident type code (e.g. TC1, TC2, FIRE).

units_dispatched.description: List of unit IDs dispatched to the incident.

oneOf.title: WazeCitizenReportEvent
oneOf.description: Crowdsourced traffic event from the Waze Connected Citizens Programme feed.

report_rating.description: Number of users who confirmed the report.

oneOf.title: GTFSRealtimeEvent
oneOf.description: Transit delay or disruption event from a GTFS-Realtime feed that may affect road network.

trip_id.description: GTFS trip_id of the affected transit trip.

stop_id.description: GTFS stop_id where the delay is occurring.
